kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتناحر (form VI)
# نَتَنَاحَرُ (natanāḥaru) /na.ta.naː.ħa.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَنَاحَرَ (tanāḥara)
# نَتَنَاحَرَ (natanāḥara) /na.ta.naː.ħa.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَنَاحَرَ (tanāḥara)
# نَتَنَاحَرْ (natanāḥar) /na.ta.naː.ħar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَنَاحَرَ (tanāḥara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
